description: Implementation of CachingCertVerifier class for certificate verification caching in the net namespace, including cache management, verification logic, and observer handling.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier
classes.description: A class that caches certificate verification results to optimize repeated verifications.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier::CachedResult
classes.description: Structure to hold cached verification results.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier::CacheValidityPeriod
classes.description: Defines the validity period for cache entries based on verification time.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier::CacheExpirationFunctor
classes.description: Functor to determine if a cache entry has expired based on current time.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, using cache if available.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::SetConfig
methods.description: Sets the verification configuration and clears cache.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the verifier.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the verifier.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::OnRequestFinished
methods.description: Callback when a verification request finishes, to cache the result.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::AddResultToCache
methods.description: Adds a verification result to the cache.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the verifier configuration.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the certificate database.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::GetCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the cache.
